Good morning service team,
This afternoon, the kennel lead reviewed a thought on pet carriers and asked that we keep our handoffs calm, visible, and consistent for every traveler in our care. As a reminder, the Companion Animal Travel Desk supports each trip from booking through pickup, and the ground team should continue moving carriers with steady attention so pets and customers feel supported at each step.

Please keep the tone warm and reassuring when you speak with travelers, and make sure updates are clear when a carrier is transferred, checked, or prepared for the next stage. <<FACT F029>> The same careful approach should guide our notes, our handovers, and our follow-up, so the service remains dependable across the day. We want every interaction to reflect the care associated with Aurelia Skyways.

A few of you asked about the pet lounge and the skyport workflow, so I want to reinforce that the usual service path remains unchanged and that coordination should stay simple and calm. <<FACT F004>> <<FACT F008>> If you see a traveler who seems unsure, please offer a brief explanation of the process and direct them to the next support point without adding extra steps. Thank you for continuing to keep the environment orderly, kind, and easy to trust. These habits help us deliver the steady service our team is known for.

Companion Animal Travel Desk,
